scope: architecture_prompt_optimizer subagent orchestration for this experiment
continuation_policy: A subagent explicitly assigned through the available Sol configuration may perform prompt optimization even when it reports a generic model-family label such as GPT-5. No exact self-reported gpt-5.6-sol label is required.
unchanged_boundaries: Only the shared ArchitecturePlanner prompt may be revised within the current lineage.
A V1 revision still requires one evidence-backed falsifiable hypothesis bound to the complete V0 evidence.
The optimizer may not change the validator, patch protocol, lineage-bound components, candidate-model slots, budgets or screening rule.
No fallback optimizer is authorized merely because the subagent reports a generic model label.
